Solid Waste (Landfill)
Home >
Departments >
Solid Waste (Landfill)
Function of Department
Accept and dispose of residential and demolition waste generated in Norton County ONLY!!!
Maintain recycling being brought in by public
Help keep the environment safe by complying with state and federal regulations
Maintain the Household Hazardous Waste program established in the county for residential customers only
Accept trees, grass, and yard waste for Norton County
Accept E-waste for recycling
Mission
To protect the environment by providing a controlled site to dispose of residential and demolition waste, to encourage wisdom in the use of materials and chemicals in the home and business, and to promote cooperation in education and resource management.
Disposal rates
MSW (RESIDENTIAL TRASH)- $80 . 00 per ton/about 4 cents a lb.
CONSTRUCTION DEMOLITION - $80.00 per ton/about 4 cents a lb.
I F CD HAS ANY TRASH, PLASTICS, CARDBOARD, CAULKING TUBES ETC. , YOU WILL BE CHARGED A SORTING FEE OR LOAD MAY BE REFUSED.
GRASS AND YARD WASTE IS FREE. YARD WASTE IS LEAVES,GRASS, AND NON WOODY GARDEN WASTE ONLY. ANY CUSTOMER CAUGHT DUMPING TRASH IN GRASS PILE WILL BE CHARGED A SORTING FEE! NO TRASH OR TREES PLEASE!!
TREES ARE FREE TO RESIDENTS ONLY.COMMERCIAL TREE COMPANIES WILL BE CHARGED A TIPPING FEE PER LOAD OF TREES.TREES MUST BE NO LONGER THAN 8 FEET IN LENGTH. NO TRASH PLEASE!!!
HOUSEHOLD HAZARDOUS WASTES ARE FREE TO BRING TO LANDFILL. ALL MUST HAVE READABLE LABELS AND NOT BE LEAKING.THIS SERVICE IS FOR RESIDENTS OF NORTON COUNTY ONLY.
TIRE DISPOSAL DEPENDS ON SIZE OF TIRE. WE WILL NOT ACCEPT ANY TIRE WITH RIMS. PLEASE CALL AHEAD FOR PRICING.
THERE IS A $25.00 FREON DISPOSAL CHARGE ON ALL REFRIGERATORS AND FREEZERS. A $5.00 CHARGE ON SMALL REFRIGERATORS AND AIR CONDITIONERS.
NORTON COUNTY SOLID WASTE HAS THE RIGHT TO REFUSE ANY UNACCEPTABLE WASTE.
F LUORESCENT BULBS ARE FREE FOR RECYCLE TO RESIDENTS,UP TO 10 BULBS. ANY BUSINESSES WILL BE CHARGED FOR DISPOSAL OF BULBS. CALL FOR PRICES.
BATTERIES ARE FREE TO RECYCLE. ALL LITHIUM BATTERIES MUST BE BROUGHT IN SEPARATELY FOR ALL OTHER ONE TIME USE AND LEAD ACID BATTERIES. LITHIUM BATTERIES MUST HAVE TERMINALS TAPED TO PREVENT SHORTING OUT. THIS SERVICE IS FOR RESIDENTS ONLY.
EWASTE IS FREE TO NORTON COUNTY RESIDENTS,BUT BUSINESSES WILL BE CHARGED.
SPECIAL WASTES,CONTAMINATED SOILS,NON FRIABLE ASBESTOS, AND PERMITTED WASTES MUST BE APPROVED BY NORTON COUNTY SOLID WASTE SUPERVISOR BEFORE DUMPING. THIS CHARGE IS $240.00 PER TON OR 12 CENTS A LB. PLEASE CALL BEFORE PLEASE
.
Norton county has a demolition program for houses, garages and outbuildings. call for details.
PLEASE CALL 785-877-5790, IF YOU HAVE ANY OTHER QUESTIONS.
RECYCLING
AS OF APRIL 4TH,2022, NORTON COUNTY IS RECYCLING THE FOLLOWING RECYCLING. ALL RECYCLING MUST BE BROUGHT TO RECYCLING CENTER,AT THE LANDFILL, AND SORTED ACCORDINGLY. ANY UNSORTED PRODUCTS WILL BE CONSIDERED RESIDENTIAL TRASH AND CHARGED FOR. NORTON COUNTY HAS THE RIGHT TO REFUSE ANY RECYCLING THAT DO NOT MEET OUR CRITERIAS.THIS IS A SERVICE FOR NORTON COUNTY RESIDENTS ONLY!!!
CARDBOARD, MUST BE CLEAN AND DRY
SHREDDED PAPER, MUST BE IN CLEAR BAG FOR INSPECTION
LOOSE PAPER, NEWSPAPERS, JUNK MAIL. NEWS PAPERS MUST BE SEPARATE FROM ALL OTHER PAPERS.
PLASTICS (MISC), BOTTLES, MILK JUGS, BOWLS, ETC.ALL MUST BE RINSED AND DRIED.AS OF AUGUST 24TH, 2023 WE DO NOT ACCEPT ANY TYPE OF PLASTIC BAGS, STYROFOAM, HERBICIDE OR PESTICIDE (AGRICULTURE) JUGS. THEY STILL MUST BE TRIPLE RINSED, DRIED, AND WITHOUT LIDS AND THEN CAN BE PLACED IN RESIDENTIAL TRASH.
ALUMINUM CANS OF ANY KIND
EWASTE-ELECTRONICS ARE FREE FOR RESIDENTS. BUSINESSES WILL BE CHARGED
AT THIS TIME TIN AND GLASS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED AS RECYCLING
